visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a black screen featuring centered white Chinese text. (2) Three male characters, dressed in white school uniforms and wearing different wigs (one long straight, one medium wavy, one short curly), are gathered in a brightly lit classroom with a chalkboard behind them. They engage in an animated conversation with lively facial expressions and hand gestures. (3) Another black screen appears with white text indicating the following morning. (4) In the classroom, one character presents a sweet potato and a carton of milk tea on a desk. A second character then displays a Zongzi and a carton of green tea. (5) A third character reveals an exceptionally large silver cooking pot on a desk and places a massive 1.5L bottle of milk tea beside it, causing the others to look visibly shocked. (6) The first two characters grab their items and exit the frame quickly, leaving the third character looking confused at his desk. (7) A fast-paced montage follows, showing a high-angle view of a school courtyard filled with a massive shower of colorful confetti and cheering students on balconies. (8) The third character is shown again in the classroom, appearing exhausted and full while leaning over the large pot. (9) Finally, two characters hold up Mai Xiang milk tea cartons in front of the classroom chalkboard, smiling at the camera.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video is a comedic advertisement for Mai Xiang milk tea, specifically targeting students during the graduation season. It uses a relatable school-life scenario—exchanging breakfasts with friends—and escalates it into a humorous situation involving a giant breakfast pot to emphasize the brand's 'versatile' and 'community' appeal. The high-energy montage of school celebrations reinforces the emotional connection to graduation memories.
